nodes.label: Floating Minimal Scrollbars (Module 2)
nodes.rationale: Backported the floating minimal scrollbars (ADR-032) to #step-card and .problem-library__body — the hidden scrollbar replaced by a 10px WebKit channel with a ~4px --color-border pill floating clear via a 3px transparent padding-box border, so learners get a 'more content below' cue in the Quiet-Chrome style.

nodes.label: White Card/Chip Surfaces
nodes.rationale: White card/chip surfaces (--color-host-white) so the sim blends with the white host page when embedded.
